ordered_diagnoses: Vascular Tumor of the Thyroid with Metastasis

candidates.name: Vascularized Thyroid Cancer (VTC) metastasis
support_spans: Endoscopic examination found a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities
Confirmed a hypervascular tumor with anterior skull base extension
Costal Biopsy: 'Pointed to VTC metastasis'
Sinonasal Tumor Biopsy: 'Confirmed VTC metastasis'
candidates.why: The presence of a highly vascularized mass in the nasal cavities, along with biopsy results confirming VTC metastasis, supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
support_spans: Serum Thyroglobulin: '4432 ng/mL (significantly elevated)'
Radioiodine Scintigraphy: 'Found considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions'
contradict_spans: The sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
candidates.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin level and the presence of metastatic lesions with considerable radioiodine uptake are consistent with papillary thyroid carcinoma.

candidates.name: Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma
support_spans: Endoscopic examination found a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities
candidates.why: The presence of a highly vascularized mass in the nasal cavities could be consistent with medullary thyroid carcinoma, but the significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin level is not typical for this diagnosis.
